Correction to the decoy rule.

## Server

### Fixed
- A record under the blank id that carries a player's name and has no sibling under a synthetic id is that player's profile, written back by the game's save path with the client's blank id. It is now adopted: the id becomes the synthetic id for the name it carries and the inventory id is aligned, at boot and at join. Only when a synthetic sibling with the same name exists is a blank record a decoy. v0.1.80 through v0.1.84 retired such a record at boot, which is why a player's last session vanished on the next restart.
